<!-- Disable nuxeo-ai-content-intelligence built-in tagging.
Why? OOTB tagging is pretty weak for images. It uses the `named-entity-recognition-image` action, which only returns proper nouns like brands, people, landmarks, specific recognizable things.
I switched to the `image-metadata-generation` action instead. But the output of this action (a string of comma-separated labels) is not understood by the OOTB tagger (which just saves the entire string as one tag). So we also switch to using Automation to assign tags.
Meanwhile this is a global setting; it disables tagging for both images and documents. So the automation must handle the OOTB output for documents, which is just named-entity-recognition-text entities. --> <extension target="org.nuxeo.runtime.stream.service" point="streamProcessor"> <streamProcessor name="storeContentIntelligenceMetadataProcessor" enabled="false" class="org.nuxeo.ai.contentintelligence.StoreContentIntelligenceMetadata"/> </extension>
